diagonals.description: A `Tensor` or tuple of `Tensor`s describing left-hand sides. The shape depends of `diagonals_format`, see description above. Must be `float32`, `float64`, `complex64`, or `complex128`.
constraints: shape [..., M, M] if compact format, or shape [..., M] for each tensor in sequence format
diagonals must be float32, float64, complex64, or complex128

rhs.description: A `Tensor` of shape [..., M, N] and with the same dtype as `diagonals`.
constraints: rhs must have the same dtype as diagonals
diagonals_format must be one of sequence, compact

output.description: A `Tensor` of shape [..., M, N] containing the result of multiplication.
